name: Payments

plan_approval.evidence: Explicit human message in the project conversation on 2026-08-08; approval applies only to the Phase 05 technical plan and implementation checkpoint.

planning_reference.reason: The approved Vidalys Flow contracts and current official provider documentation are sufficient. No Flowlog code, runtime, data, IDs, migrations, credentials, infrastructure, endpoints, or behavior is required.

recommended_rollout.canonical_core: Implement the provider-neutral payment aggregate before any adapter.
recommended_rollout.provider_a: Mercado Pago Checkout Pro hosted checkout, because the official documentation exposes signed webhook validation and a test flow.
recommended_rollout.provider_b: Pagar.me v5 Payment Links after its webhook authenticity contract is confirmed with official support or account documentation; provider-resource re-fetch is mandatory and raw callbacks are never trusted as canonical facts.
recommended_rollout.deferred_provider: Appmax remains deferred until the canonical core and both first adapters are stable and account-specific official API, authentication, webhook, idempotency, sandbox, and support contracts are available.
recommended_rollout.production_effects: No production credential, real charge, public webhook registration, or provider enablement belongs to this checkpoint.

expected_models.name: PaymentIntent
expected_models.purpose: Organization-scoped canonical full-Order payment aggregate with immutable BRL amount snapshot, lifecycle, version, and no provider-specific state.

expected_models.name: PaymentAttempt
expected_models.purpose: One serialized hosted-checkout attempt for a PaymentIntent, including provider choice, sanitized external identifiers, link lifecycle, expiry, and provider idempotency key.

expected_models.name: PaymentProviderAccount
expected_models.purpose: Organization-scoped non-secret provider configuration and opaque credential reference; credentials and tokens never enter PostgreSQL.

expected_models.name: PaymentStatusHistory
expected_models.purpose: Immutable canonical transition history separate from AuditEvent and provider callback history.

expected_models.name: PaymentCommandReceipt
expected_models.purpose: Organization-scoped idempotency receipt for every mutable payment command.

expected_models.name: PaymentWebhookReceipt
expected_models.purpose: Deduplication and processing evidence containing only provider, account, external event/resource identifiers, request digest, canonical result, and timestamps; never a raw callback.

expected_features: Create one canonical full-value PaymentIntent only for a confirmed, non-cancelled Order and snapshot the persisted Order total in BRL.
Create hosted-checkout attempts asynchronously through a provider adapter and transactional outbox without holding database locks during network I/O.
Expose Mercado Pago Checkout Pro and Pagar.me v5 Payment Link adapters behind explicit configuration and disabled external effects.

Accept provider callbacks only through provider-account-scoped endpoints, authenticate or independently verify them, deduplicate them, discard raw PII, re-fetch the authoritative resource, and map it to canonical states.
Provide reconciliation commands for stale or inconsistent intents without automatic provider fallback.
Consume sanitized Order cancellation events to close open intents when safe and surface already-paid cancellations as requires_attention without issuing a refund.
Provide organization-scoped selectors, manager operations, masked operator visibility, server-rendered HTML, audit, and sanitized internal outbox events.
deferred_features: partial payments, deposits, split tender, multiple currencies, overpayment allocation, credit balance, and receivables ledger
automatic refund, partial refund, reversal, dispute, chargeback, fraud decisioning, and delivery blocking
transparent checkout, card tokenization, storage of cardholder data, recurring billing, subscriptions, saved cards, and one-click payment
automatic fallback or routing between providers, smart retries, fee optimization, MDR accounting, settlement, anticipation, and bank reconciliation
Appmax adapter, Pix QR rendering inside Vidalys Flow, boleto PDF handling, and direct payment capture
Messaging delivery of links, public API, importers, fiscal, inventory, dashboard, Coolify, homologation, production credentials, and deploy

states.requirement: Proposed canonical state contract requiring human approval before implementation.
states.rule: Provider statuses are evidence mapped by adapters and never persisted as PaymentIntent.status. requires_attention is a non-terminal operational exception that only a verified reconciliation command may resolve.
states.single_active_attempt: At most one requested, active, or processing attempt may exist per PaymentIntent. Switching providers requires verified closure of the prior attempt; fallback is never automatic.

eligibility_and_order_coordination: PaymentIntent creation locks and revalidates the Organization-scoped Order as confirmed and not cancelled.
Phase 05 supports only exact full-Order payment using Order.total persisted in BRL; Fulfillment state never gates payment.
Payments imports approved Orders contracts; Orders does not import Payments and its canonical status remains draft, confirmed, or cancelled.
An order.cancelled event cancels pending or awaiting payment intent work when the provider confirms closure.
If the Order is cancelled after verified payment, the PaymentIntent becomes requires_attention and emits a sanitized operational event; no automatic refund is invented in this phase.
A paid intent never marks Order completed and does not release, complete, or rewrite Fulfillment.
snapshots: PaymentIntent snapshots Order id, display number, currency BRL, exact persisted grand total, customer display name, and only the minimum provider-required customer fields under a closed versioned schema.

PaymentAttempt stores the hosted URL and sanitized provider identifiers but never credentials, access tokens, signatures, raw headers, raw callbacks, card data, CVV, full PAN, or provider response bodies.
Provider payload construction reads only confirmed Order snapshots; it never relays current Customer or Product records silently.

OPERATOR receives payment state, amount, provider display name, expiry, and the active hosted link required for manual sharing; external IDs, reconciliation evidence, provider account metadata, and customer PII remain manager-only.
AuditEvent and OutboxEvent contain canonical IDs, state, amount, currency, version, and boolean reason flags only.
idempotency: Every mutable local command uses PaymentCommandReceipt scoped by Organization, operation, and idempotency key with canonical payload hashing.
Each outbound attempt has one stable provider idempotency key reused after timeout; a retry never creates a new attempt merely because the provider response was lost.
External resource IDs are unique per PaymentProviderAccount and never globally trusted without Organization and provider account scope.
Webhook receipts deduplicate by provider event ID when guaranteed, otherwise by a documented canonical digest plus provider resource ID; duplicate and out-of-order callbacks are safe.
Reconciliation locks Order then PaymentIntent then PaymentAttempt in deterministic order, re-fetches the authoritative resource, and applies only monotonic canonical transitions.
Network I/O occurs outside database transactions through outbox-driven workers; leases and retries prevent simultaneous provider calls for the same attempt.
money_rules: Currency is BRL and canonical money uses Decimal(14,2) with ROUND_HALF_UP; provider integer minor units are converted only at adapter boundaries with exact divisibility checks.
The server copies the persisted confirmed Order grand total and never accepts amount, fee, discount, surcharge, freight, interest, or installment total from the browser.
Phase 05 supports no partial, split, multi-intent aggregate, fee, interest, provider discount, or currency conversion behavior.
A verified provider amount or currency mismatch never marks paid; it moves the intent to requires_attention and emits sanitized evidence.
Provider fees, installments with interest, settlement amounts, receivables, and accounting remain outside the canonical Order total and are deferred.
provider_and_webhook_security: Hosted checkout is mandatory; Vidalys Flow never renders or receives full card number, CVV, card token, or cardholder authentication data.
Provider credentials live only in an approved secret channel and are referenced by opaque aliases; they never enter models, fixtures, logs, CI, handoffs, or Git.
Mercado Pago callbacks require official secret-signature validation before processing and an authoritative API re-fetch before canonical transition.

Pagar.me callbacks remain disabled until an official authenticity mechanism is confirmed; account/resource correlation and authoritative API re-fetch are mandatory but do not alone replace transport authentication without explicit Security approval.
Callback bodies may contain documents, contacts, addresses, card metadata, and provider diagnostics; raw bodies and headers are processed ephemerally, size-limited, never logged, and never persisted.
Public callback endpoints use HTTPS, strict methods/content types, replay protection, rate limits, generic responses, and no Organization ID supplied by the caller.
Appmax remains outside implementation because current public product material confirms API availability but does not establish the complete technical security contract required by this phase.
authorization: Organization for human commands comes from authenticated active Membership and is never accepted as a free request identifier.
OWNER, ADMIN, and MANAGER may create PaymentIntents, choose an enabled provider, request or cancel hosted links, and run reconciliation.
OWNER, ADMIN, MANAGER, and OPERATOR may list and view canonical payment status and copy the current hosted link for manual sharing; this phase sends no message automatically.
Only OWNER, ADMIN, and MANAGER may view external identifiers, provider-account metadata, webhook/reconciliation evidence, amount mismatches, and requires_attention details.
Callback Organization is derived from a configured provider account endpoint and verified provider evidence, never from payload organization fields.
Every selector, service, worker, callback, and admin surface has direct cross-organization tests.

acceptance_criteria: The complete canonical lifecycle, full-Order-only rule, provider rollout, paid-Order cancellation handling, permissions, and deferred scope are explicitly approved before implementation.
The implementation starts exactly from actual_base_sha 4fd3a9259e9e2f31acdab44f13499eade79ab59e and depends on approved Phase 04 head 888685886d7a17c6eeb008674be86656e4f6fa40.
No Flowlog asset is consulted or reused and no Appmax, Messaging, inventory, fiscal, deploy, refund, subscription, or transparent-checkout code is introduced.
Order amount and BRL currency are exact, server-derived, immutable per intent, and verified against authoritative provider resources before paid.
Only one active provider attempt exists per intent and duplicate or excess payment risk is surfaced rather than hidden.
Callback authenticity, provider-account scope, deduplication, replay protection, PII disposal, and authoritative re-fetch are enforced and directly tested.
No provider network call occurs in request transactions or CI; external effects remain disabled without separately approved sandbox or production activation.
Organization isolation, authorization, masking, idempotency, expected_version, deterministic locks, and sanitization are enforced and tested.
All gates and CI pass on the candidate HEAD, independent Review has no unresolved blocker, and QA/Security emits GO.
Human approval remains explicit before implementation, sandbox access, PR, merge, release, provider enablement, deploy, state approval, or the next phase.
human_decisions_required: Approve full-Order-only payments with one active hosted-checkout attempt and no partial payments.
Approve Mercado Pago Checkout Pro as provider A and Pagar.me v5 Payment Links as provider B, with Appmax deferred.
Approve disabling Pagar.me callback processing until its authenticity contract is confirmed by official evidence and Security Review.
Approve OWNER, ADMIN, and MANAGER for mutations, with OPERATOR limited to status visibility and copying an active hosted link.
Approve requires_attention, without automatic refund, when a paid payment conflicts with Order cancellation or provider amount/currency.
Approve Pix, boleto, and credit card only through provider-hosted checkout; no transparent checkout, subscriptions, split, fees, or provider discounts.
Approve that implementation and CI use fakes/contract fixtures only; sandbox calls require a later explicit authorization.

allowed_scope: Planning and, only after explicit plan approval, a new provider-neutral greenfield Payments domain for exact full-Order BRL hosted-checkout links.
Minimal one-way adapters from Payments to approved Orders, Organizations, Audit, and Platform contracts without Orders importing Payments.
Mercado Pago Checkout Pro adapter and Pagar.me v5 Payment Link adapter behind disabled external effects, using fake/contract fixtures in implementation and CI.
New Payments models, services, selectors, policies, callbacks, workers, tests, migrations, server-rendered interfaces, documentation, audit, and sanitized internal outbox integration.
forbidden_scope: Implementing code before human approval of this plan or making any provider, sandbox, webhook-registration, credential, production, deploy, or Coolify change.
